title: Eth.id
tagline: Is your .eth already taken?  Eth.id is your Web 3 profile page: https://chris.eth.id Get a powerful ENS domain that works on both Web and Eth.  No renewals.  Pay once, yours forever.
description: It's hard to make a website with an Ethereum domain.  Eth.id offers you an ENS domain: [YOUR_NAME].eth.id.  This domain works on your Chrome browser, without extensions.  Eth.id provides a Facebook-like profile that lives on the address.  You can customize it with your links, make social posts, share your profile.   As it is also a valid ENS domain, it works on Metamask, Etherscan, any application that has an ENS integration.  Having a single, identical domain that points to both your Web identity and Ethereum identity makes Eth.id the definitive name to own.
how_its_made: Eth.id is made with deep integration with the ENS contracts.  It utilizes server-side execution of creating subdomains, updating subnode records, updating text fields to provide a seamless experience for the user.   The OpenSea API was utilized to query for NFT data owned by wallets that would be used for NFT selection of profile and cover images.  Alchemy was the data provider utilized for blockchain lookup.    The bulk of the stack lives on AWS, using RDS / PostgreSQL for the database, Elastic Beanstalk for serving frontend, Node.js for backend, React / Typescript for frontend.
